name: Hell Roulette
storyline: Every cat that dies ends up in Hell, where a place called the Hall of the Last Bet once served as a court to judge whether a soul deserved to return to life. Over time, that dry bureaucratic process degraded into a gambling ritual: cats no longer receive a verdict by decree, they have to win it back at the table, betting the only currency that matters in the afterlife: the years of their sentence. Round after round, dead cats disguised as mobsters, hustlers, and card sharps gather at the table, wagering their time in Hell on the turn of a revolver's cylinder. Those who clear their debt earn the right to be reborn and move on to the next league, where new rules and tougher challenges await.
summary: Congratulations, you're dead again! Bet years of your sentence in Hell and earn your way back to life by reducing your debt to zero. Bid for the revolver like you're playing poker, take risks like you're playing Russian roulette, and claim the pot while everyone at the table tries to stop you.
